cards.title: Rare genetic disorder: one family's fight for their daughter
cards.body: A mother shares her journey raising her daughter Elsie, who was born with an ultra-rare genetic disorder affecting only 163 million people. After decades in film PR, she now faces her biggest campaign: fighting for her child's life.

cards.title: Middle-class parents neglect essential life skills for children
cards.body: Experts argue that many middle-class families fail to teach kids crucial domestic abilities like laundry and cooking before university. This gap leaves students unprepared for independent living.

cards.title: Kindness restores a parent's faith during messy moment
cards.body: When a child became sick in the car on a busy motorway, an overwhelmed parent received unexpected help from a stranger. A simple gesture of compassion turned a stressful situation into a powerful reminder of human kindness.

cards.title: Location tracking: parental surveillance comes with mental cost
cards.body: Parents increasingly use tracking apps to monitor loved ones' movements for safety. But constant surveillance may create anxiety rather than peace of mind.

cards.title: Finding suburban life with kids: it's what you make it
cards.body: A family's suburban move initially felt boring and isolating. By actively seeking community and activities, they discovered their new neighborhood offered unexpected joy and belonging.

cards.title: IKEA prep reveals parents' gaps in teaching domestic skills
cards.body: Pre-university shopping trips expose how little children have learned about home essentials and independent living. Parents discover uncomfortable truths about their parenting choices.

cards.title: Why birth rates are falling: economic and social pressures
cards.body: Fewer people are choosing parenthood due to housing costs, dating app culture, job insecurity, and climate concerns. Understanding these barriers is crucial for policymakers and society.

cards.title: Postpartum psychosis: when mental health system fails mothers
cards.body: The case of Lindsay Clancy highlights the dangers of undiagnosed or untreated postpartum psychosis. Failures in mental health support can have devastating consequences for vulnerable new mothers.

cards.title: Young athletes turning away from football for safer sports
cards.body: Parents increasingly choose alternative activities over football due to injury and concussion concerns. This shift raises questions about the sport's future generation of players.

cards.title: Father pays tribute to three-year-old son Noah Woods
cards.body: Rhys Woods honors his young son and expresses gratitude to community supporters. The brief tribute reflects a parent's love during difficult circumstances.
